rules.H1_q_is_the_knob: Straight line, no loss, 0.3 s: (a) at true noise 0.02 m and 0.10 m, the best grid q told 5 cm has a median p95 at or below the q = 0.1 told_truth median p95; (b) at 0.10 m that best-q cell passes.
rules.H2_one_fixed_q: Some single grid q, told 5 cm, (a) never turns a cell that passes at q = 0.1 into a fail (all 36 conditions) and (b) in every no-loss condition (18) has a median p95 within 0.02 m of the best grid q for that condition.
rules.H3_schedule_worth_a_later_proposal: Oracle schedule: on straight conditions the grid q with the smallest worst-case regret over straight no-loss conditions, on turn conditions the same for turns (told 5 cm). Single q: smallest worst-case regret over all 18 no-loss conditions. Passes if the schedule beats the single q by at least 0.02 m median p95 in at least 3 no-loss conditions, or turns at least one of the 36 conditions from fails to passes. Upper bound: the schedule knows the motion with no lag.
rules.R0_reproduction: At q = 0.1, told_5cm equals the registered runs/s6-recovery recovery arm per seed (p95 and max, exact) wherever that cell exists, told_truth at 0.10 m with no loss equals its oracle slice, and every q = 0.1 cell equals runs/s6-adaptive-r told_5cm and told_truth. If R0 fails the run is void.
rules.cell_label: a cell fails when at least half of its 50 seeds fail (p95 > 0.25 m or max > 0.50 m)
rules.regret: median p95 at that q minus the smallest median p95 over the grid, same condition, told 5 cm
rules.ties: added after the critic review, matching the code as first written: on a tie the smaller grid q wins

design.statistic: per-condition median of per-seed p95 error (recovery arm only), order-statistic 95% interval, Wilson interval for failure rates

status: EXP-040 proposal: synthetic link and sensor, not flight performance, not registered
